title: MPX EncounterPlus V5 Spell
description: A compendium spell authored directly as a project file.

id.markdownDescription: *Required.* Persistent UUID of the spell. Keep this value unchanged once the spell has been used in a build.
id.patternErrorMessage: The spell id must be a valid UUID.

slug.markdownDescription: *Required.* Stable text identifier without accents or spaces. Separate words with hyphens. Each content item in the module must use a different slug.
slug.patternErrorMessage: The slug must contain only lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (no spaces, accents, or uppercase).

attributes.markdownDescription: *Optional.* Measurement system and ruleset this spell's values are written for.

measurement.markdownDescription:
*Optional.* Measurement system used for range and area values.

Possible values: `""` (default), `"metric"`, `"imperial"`.

ruleset.markdownDescription:
*Optional.* Ruleset this spell's data follows.

Possible values: `""` (default), `"5e"`, `"5.5e"`.

data.markdownDescription: *Optional.* Spell statistics. Every field is itself optional — delete any that don't apply to this spell.

level.markdownDescription:
*Optional.* Spell level, `0` for a cantrip.

Possible values: `0`-`9`.

ritual.markdownDescription:
*Optional.* Whether the spell can be cast as a ritual.

Possible values: `true` or `false` (default).

time.markdownDescription: *Optional.* Casting time value, in the unit set by `unit`.

examples: which you take when you see a creature within 60 feet of you casting a spell

rangeType.markdownDescription:
*Optional.* Special range category. Leave unset (and use `range` instead) for a spell with a distance measured in feet — the two are mutually exclusive.

Possible values: `""` (default), `"self"`, `"touch"`, `"sight"`, `"unlimited"`.

range.markdownDescription: *Optional.* Range, in feet, when `rangeType` is not set.

areaEffectShape.markdownDescription:
*Optional.* Area of effect shape.

Possible values: `""` (default), `"cone"`, `"cube"`, `"cylinder"`, `"line"`, `"square"`, `"sphere"`, `"emanation"`.

areaEffectSize.markdownDescription: *Optional.* Area of effect size, in feet.

components.markdownDescription:
*Optional.* Spell components.

Possible values: `"V"` (verbal), `"S"` (somatic), `"M"` (material).

Example: `["V", "S", "M"]`

Empty: `[]`

componentsDetail.markdownDescription: *Optional.* Material component detail, shown when `components` includes `"M"`.
examples: a tiny ball of bat guano and sulfur

durationType.markdownDescription:
*Optional.* Duration category. Leave unset (and use `duration`/`durationUnit`) for a plain timed duration; `"concentration"` also uses `duration`/`durationUnit` alongside it.

Possible values: `""` (default), `"concentration"`, `"instantaneous"`, `"special"`, `"dispel"`, `"dispelOrTrigger"`.

duration.markdownDescription: *Optional.* Duration value, in the unit set by `durationUnit`, used when `durationType` is unset or `"concentration"`.

classes.markdownDescription:
*Optional.* Classes that can cast this spell, referencing a class entity as `"ClassName|sourceCode"`. Class entities aren't validated yet.

Example: `["Wizard|phb-2024"]`

Empty: `[]`

examples: A bright streak flashes from your pointing finger.

image.markdownDescription: *Optional.* Path to the spell's image, relative to the project root. Save the image directly inside the `spells` folder at the project root.
image.patternErrorMessage: The image path must point to a file stored directly inside the project's spells folder.

sources.markdownDescription:
*Optional.* Sourcebook references for this spell.

Example: `[{ "name": "Player's Handbook", "page": 241 }]`

Empty: `[]`

tags.markdownDescription:
*Optional.* Array of keywords used to describe and find the spell.

Example: `["damage", "fire"]`

Empty: `[]`
